snippet.title: Rewilders: The Lost Spring - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the Rewilders: The Lost Spring reveal trailer for the upcoming open-world action roguelite with creature collection and metroidvania-like progression from Herobeat (developer of Endling: Extinction is Forever). The Rewilders: The Lost Spring trailer showcases its world and gives a glimpse into the journey you'll embark on as Abi, a survivor returning to the poisoned surface of the world to rescue her lost family and restore the wild.
